metadata.title: EMSA HI October 2026 locked analysis verification package
metadata.description: Current locked Fig1–5 and S1–S7 analysis-level inputs, conditional fusion replay, saved-model verification, selection and clinical missingness audits. Distinct from the June 2026 record. Includes archived branch scores and downstream models, but does not claim complete raw-assay-to-model reproducibility. Small refit-to-locked numerical differences are explicitly documented.
metadata.notes: Metadata draft only. Confirm author list, software/data licences and public-release authority before depositing. No unpublished manuscript or private author documents are included.
